data.name: Lithos
data.description: Lithos Carbon is a San Francisco-based pure-play CDR supplier using Enhanced Rock Weathering by applying crushed basalt rock dust to US farmland to permanently remove CO2 while improving soil health and crop yields. The company has a $57.1M Frontier offtake and a multi-year Microsoft deal, and in December 2025 delivered 5,160 registry-certified tons—reportedly the largest ERW issuance to date.
